demo: Sample data. Your real classes will appear here in the next update.

roster.title: Class {{name}}
roster.tableCaption: Students in this class, with their progress and best-fit path

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.note: Two-step sign-in is required. Students don't sign in here.

setup.title: Set up two-step sign-in
setup.intro: You do this once. After that, you only type a code from your phone.
setup.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
setup.step2: In the app, add an account and choose “Enter a setup key”. Name it Rahyaab and type this key:
setup.step3: The app now shows a 6-digit code that changes every 30 seconds. Type it below.
setup.keepSafe: Don't share this key or a photo of it.

code.title: Enter your 6-digit code
code.label: 6-digit code
code.lostPhone: Lost your phone? Ask your school's Rahyaab admin to reset your two-step sign-in.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Type your work email. We'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a link. It works once, for 30 minutes.
forgot.note: You'll still need your two-step code after resetting.

reset.title: Choose a password
reset.hint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember, like “green tea at four”.
reset.done: Your password is saved. Sign in with it now.
reset.noToken: This link is not complete. Open it again from your email, or ask for a new one.

errors.mfa_failed: That code didn't work. Check the code in your app and try again.
errors.challenge_expired: That took too long. Please sign in again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait {{minutes}} minutes and try again.
errors.reset_link_invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.mfa_setup_needed: Ask your school's Rahyaab admin to reset your two-step sign-in.
errors.network: We couldn't reach Rahyaab. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.common: That password is too easy to guess. Try a short sentence instead.
errors.contains_email: Don't use your email name in your password.
errors.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.email: Type your full email, like name@school.edu.pk.
errors.code: Type the 6 digits from your app.
